title: Sources: Nscale must seek a US license to provide ByteDance remote access to Nvidia GPUs under new rules; ByteDance made up ~73% of Nscale's 2025 revenue (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Nscale must seek a US license to provide ByteDance remote access to Nvidia GPUs under new rules; ByteDance made up ~73% of Nscale's 2025 revenue — Nscale Plc's agreement to sell artificial intelligence computing capacity to ByteDance Ltd. will come under greater regulatory scrutiny …
